# Production's genotype tables for src/ng/calling/genotype_table_parity.rs, frozen at promotion
# plan step C5. Built by production's shape_for(ploidy, n_alleles)
# (src/var_calling/posterior_engine/shape.rs) at commit d9e7b076, for every shape the test compares.
#
# A shape opens with `shape <ploidy> <alleles> <genotype count>`, followed by one line per genotype
# in production's enumeration order: the genotype as its alleles, one base-36 digit per copy in
# ascending allele order (so the allele counts are recoverable exactly); the log multinomial
# coefficient as its IEEE-754 bit pattern in 16 hex digits; and the homozygous allele as a
# base-36 digit, or `-` for a heterozygous genotype.
